title: Field size times bias numerator bound
statement: Let $n$, $a$, and $b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$. Define $S=\lceil nb/a\rceil$ and $D=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 S\rceil)$. Then $2^D a\le 4nb$.
